editorial:
If you love intense family dramas with a dark revenge twist, this one will grab your attention right away. The story follows two sisters, Lim Da-yeong and Lim Da-jeong, whose bond is destroyed when the older sister steals the younger one's lover, Yoon Tae-jin, and even locks her away in a mental hospital. Years later, Da-jeong escapes and teams up with a fellow patient to turn the tables on her sister and Tae-jin. The setup is wild and emotional, and it keeps you wondering who will win this twisted family war. The pacing moves quickly, and the tension between the sisters feels raw and personal.

The acting is strong, especially in the scenes where Da-jeong takes control and forces her sister and former lover into a harsh, slave-like life. It is not an easy watch, since the revenge gets pretty brutal and uncomfortable at times. Still, if you enjoy dark melodramas about betrayal and payback, you will find plenty to talk about. Fans of intense Korean-style thrillers should give it a shot.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Da-jeong's revenge plan reaches its peak as she forces Da-yeong and Tae-jin through even harsher punishments. Just when it seems she has fully won, the pair find a way to fight back with a scary plot of their own. The movie ends on a tense, open note, leaving you wondering whether the sisters will ever find peace or if their cycle of cruelty will continue forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark family dramas and revenge thrillers.
